criteria.INTERACT: Interact with the adjacent tile you face
criteria.NORTH: Move up one tile and face north
criteria.SOUTH: Move down one tile and face south
criteria.WEST: Move left one tile and face west

action.instructions: Choose one native action to cooperate with your teammate and deliver the allowed soups. Face a station before interacting; in manual-cooking mode start a full idle pot with empty hands. Yield narrow paths and avoid duplicating your teammate's work.
